_purpose: Answer key for the reference scenario in data/scenario/min-demo.json (steps S1-S11, requests R1-R5 of the eight seed questions). Every expected value was derived by reading the passages and authority metadata in data/seed/seed.json and the rules in data/seed/domain.md. It was drafted with AI assistance, checked against the passages by a separate AI review agent, and approved row by row by the author. It was never taken from application output. Mechanical checks are graded by code; meaning checks (expected facts and forbidden claims in plain words) are graded by a recorded Gemini judge plus the author's sign-off. gold_passages (added with the retrieval change, decision 042) are the current passages that answer each question, read from derived_from; the grader reports retrieval recall@k against them. The key for the extended questionnaire is under "extended".

extended._purpose: Answer key for the extended scenario in data/scenario/extended-demo.json (steps S1-S5, requests R1-R3 of the extended questionnaire X1-X26, over the seed documents plus data/additions/extended.json).
